name: SonaliSavran Floating Chat Button
author: sonalisavran

sections.description:
SonaliSavran Floating Chat Button adds a responsive floating chat button to your website so visitors can reach you in one click. Configure everything from the WordPress admin: colors, position, spacing, size, animations, and device visibility — no theme edits or custom code needed.

The plugin works with popular mobile messaging click-to-chat links, making it easy for visitors on desktop, tablet, or mobile to start a conversation.

Key Features

  • Floating chat button — always visible, stays out of the way of your content
  • Easy setup — enable the button, enter your number, and save
  • Custom colors — background, text, and hover colors
  • Position controls — left or right side with adjustable spacing
  • Button sizes — small, medium, or large
  • Custom button text and tooltip
  • Mobile and desktop visibility — show on desktop, tablet, mobile, or any combination
  • Open in a new tab option
  • Animations — pulse, bounce, or none
  • Lightweight frontend — vanilla JavaScript, no jQuery dependency
  • Pre-filled default message for faster conversations

Smart Lead Capture

Collect visitor details before opening the chat link:

  • Professional popup form (name, phone, email, message)
  • Leads saved inside WordPress
  • Admin leads table with search and pagination
  • Mark leads as New or Contacted
  • Bulk delete and CSV export
  • Optional email notification to the site admin
  • Privacy policy checkbox support

Why SonaliSavran Floating Chat Button?

  • Built with the WordPress Settings API
  • Sanitized inputs and escaped outputs
  • Translation ready
  • Clean, object-oriented architecture
  • Optimized for performance
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sonalisavran-floating-chat-button folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Floating Chat Button to configure your button.
  4. Enter your phone number with country code and save settings.
  5. Visit your website to see the floating chat button.
sections.faq:
Where do I configure the plugin?

Go to Settings → Floating Chat Button in your WordPress dashboard.

Where can I view captured leads?

Go to Chat Leads in the WordPress admin menu.

Do I need a business account?

No. Any valid mobile number works with click-to-chat links.

Does this plugin use jQuery?

No. The frontend uses modern vanilla JavaScript.

Can I show the button only on mobile?

Yes. Use the responsive visibility options to control desktop, tablet, and mobile display independently.

  • Added optional email notifications
  • Improved AJAX security and error handling

1.0.0

  • Initial release with floating chat button
  • Customizable appearance and positioning
  • Responsive display options
